description: A habit that Coach Fred Hoiberg, Nebraska's basketball coach, developed this past year—and one that drew national attention during the team's March Madness run—was asking his players in the locker room after each game, "Are you satisfied?" The resounding response was always a thundering, "No!" The team wanted more: more chances to win, more chances
